cues.text: Welcome to Num-Num Numbers. Today, we are counting Lucas numbers inside a sunny clock tower.

cues.text: Our special number wheel remembers two numbers. When they come together, a new number appears.
cues.direction_ja: 上の二入力を順に淡く強調。次の結果は先出ししない。

cues.text: Look at the rule. Each new Lucas number is the sum of the two numbers just before it.
cues.direction_ja: Lₙ=Lₙ₋₂+Lₙ₋₁、n≥2。添字と入力領域を線で結ぶ。

cues.text: We choose two starting numbers first. Then we will use the same adding rule, again and again.
